vocabulary: media-spec (kinds picture/sound/tier/lang/cut). A chip is one mark standing frameless; a drawn badge only where no artwork exists. `symbol` is the poster (sm) artwork, `lockup` the rail (md) artwork; brand = official hex for tone=brand; marks with intrinsic colours (the flag) ignore tone.
cap: Every mark with a lockup states `cap`: the height of the lockup's primary word's capitals over the artwork's height, measured once on a render in a column holding only those capitals (DOLBY, not the D symbol; dts and flac by their ascenders, and dts-HD by its dts, never its smaller HD, so a family's brand word is one size; opus, lowercase without ascenders, by its x-height / 0.7). The disc logos lead with a shape, not a word (their words are small print), so Blu-ray is measured by its swoosh and Ultra HD Blu-ray by its black box, which keeps the two discs one height. The lockup is drawn at 1cap / cap tall, so its capitals equal the capitals of the font it stands in. null = the lockup carries no word (the flag, the badges) and is sized as a symbol.

value_to_mark.resolution.1080p: two-line drawn badge '1080p' / 'FULL HD' (badge-hd is reference only)
value_to_mark.resolution.2160p: two-line drawn badge '4K' / 'ULTRA HD' (badge-4k is reference only)
value_to_mark.resolution.4320p: two-line drawn badge '8K' / 'ULTRA HD' (badge-8k is reference only)
value_to_mark.range.hdr10: drawn badge 'HDR10' (the hdr10 artwork is the geometry reference, not wired)
value_to_mark.object.dts-x: drawn badge 'DTS:X' (no free DTS:X artwork exists)
value_to_mark.codec.flac: flac (md; a drawn badge at sm, no symbol)
value_to_mark.codec.opus: opus (md; a drawn badge at sm, no symbol)
value_to_mark.codec.other: drawn badge (AAC, PCM, ALAC, MP3, MP2, Vorbis)
value_to_mark.tier.bluray: bluray, or ultra-hd-bluray when the strip knows resolution=2160p
value_to_mark.tier.remux: bluray mark, then a drawn 'Remux' badge (ultra-hd-bluray at 2160p)
value_to_mark.lang: the flag keyed by the tag's region subtag (ES → flag-es), then at md a drawn badge with the language's display name; no flag → the drawn badge alone

composition.law: ARTWORK FIRST. A chip is one mark standing FRAMELESS (the artwork is the chip: lockups keep their shape, symbols their glyph); a drawn badge (rounded box + word, HDR10-badge geometry) only for a value with no artwork; the resolution badge is the disc-case badge drawn in that family ('4K' over 'ULTRA HD').
composition.emphasis: light, never geometry: ghost (55%) · plain (resting) · lit (a soft glow in the badge ink: box shadow on a drawn badge, drop shadow on a mark's silhouette) · vivid (a stronger glow, the frame at the full ink; one colour per chip). No wash, no ring, no added shape.
composition.axes: picture = [resolution] [range] (SDR omitted); sound = [object] [codec] [channels] (beside an object mark the codec is drawn); tier = [disc] [Remux]; lang = [flag] [name]; cut = [mark or drawn].
composition.rungs: sm = brand symbols and drawn badges; md = lockups, each at its `cap` so its capitals equal the drawn badges' words. Strip groups per axis: tight gap within an axis, wider between axes.
composition.trailing: a consumer's node after an axis's last chip.
